text: SUPERVISOR: USER bug report from the live session, verbatim: "not that i need a window on a roof exactly but the fact that it even shows up and then fails is problematic" — with per-click console errors: [js.err] [dispatch] error type=onClick: buildings: refusing a malformed def — prefab.test[20]: kind 'roof' accepts no edits (stack: redefine → setPieceEdit → onPress in the buildings panel). The def validator is CORRECT to refuse; the bug is the panel OFFERING an edit control for a piece kind whose def accepts no edits. Marker: ROOFAFFORD-0607. Fix the affordance, not the validator: the buildings panel must derive which edit controls it shows from the def's actual editability — non-editable kinds get no edit affordance, nothing renders that can only fail. Do NOT touch the chip-wall→swatch panel respec (that's another lane's queued slice) — this is scoped to affordance derivation only. Evidence: before/after of the panel on a roof piece + a test that a no-edits kind yields no edit affordances. This slots ahead of AUTHBUILD-REMOVE in your queue.
